engine: Springs 'Open the doors' coupled-split: a vertical clip-path render strip (right) + per-line heading reveal + rising inset (left), TWO scroll-systems on ONE pinned scrub. Harvested from the frame-by-frame teardown of springs.estate.

measured_teardown.right_strip: stack of >=2 renders; incoming (lower) render revealed UPWARD by shrinking its TOP inset clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0)->inset(0). Lower-covers-upper, crisp full-width horizontal seam. scroll-scrubbed 1:1, reversible (seam returns down on scroll-up). NOT a fade, NOT two opposite slides — single-axis vertical clip reveal.
measured_teardown.seam_curve: per-frame seam % (region ~642px): f015 100% -> f016 43% -> f017 14% -> parks 0%, decelerating into the stop (clamped at the edge, not eased). Geared to scroll, ~one sweep per ~0.5s of scroll-time at the scrub speed.
measured_teardown.left_coupled: SAME scroll beat: heading reveals per-line (each line rises from under an overflow:hidden clip; f016 2 lines @ seam 43%, f017 3 lines @ seam 14% — third line reveals as seam climbs) AND an inset portrait rises from below the fold. Then a sticky-media / scrolling-text finish.
measured_teardown.the_parallel: two decoupled scroll-driven systems in one column-pair off one scroll position — that is the 'more custom than EVER' move (not literally two opposite slides).

lerp.what: Lenis smoothing (verbatim from slice-clip engine laws).

pinFactor.what: pin length = innerHeight * pinFactor * max(1, handoffs). Longer = slower per-frame seam delta = buttery.

headingLines.what: selector of the per-line clip wraps in the left heading (each contains a .ds-line__i that rises).

inset.what: the rising inset photo on the left (optional).

manageLenis.what: create + drive a Lenis instance; set false if the page already owns one (one scroll owner per page).

timing_layout.strip_window: handoffs spread across the first ~72% of the pin progress (each render i>=1 reveals over its own even slice).
timing_layout.heading_lines: ls = 0.04 + k*0.10, le = ls + 0.26 (staggered per line, early in the pin).

entry: DualSlicer.init(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, render, refresh, destroy }. Markup-first: .ds-render children in .ds-right are the strip; .ds-line/.ds-line__i are the heading lines; .ds-inset the rising photo.
law: Lenis 1.1.13 lerp 0.1 -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0); render(prog) PURE fn; pin/pinSpacing/scrub:true; clip-path(inset) + transform + opacity only; GPU layers; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO video.currentTime; NO WebGL; reduced-motion / <=820px -> static stacked. ONE scroll owner per page.
gate_mode: SLICER (= curtain-mode CURTAIN=1): the overlap of two solid renders during the clip-reveal is the TECHNIQUE (lower solid + upper clipping over it), so coSolid/seam are EXPECTED; blank/jank/fps stay hard.
proven: lab rebuilds the engine on OUR content: 3 QUADRO renders in the right strip + Ukrainian per-line heading + a rising inset. Gate (SLICER mode) PASS: 0 blank, 59.9fps, jank 2/842. Mid-scroll verified: render1 seam at 53.7% while heading lines at 34/59/66px and inset at 279px — right slicer + left reveal moving together on one scroll.
